description: This file is the source code for the Leaflet JavaScript library version 1.6.0, which provides functionalities for interactive maps, including utility functions, geometrical classes (Point, Bounds, LatLng, LatLngBounds), coordinate reference system definitions, and browser feature detection.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Base class for creating extendable classes with inheritance, static properties, mixins, and hooks, used internally by Leaflet.

classes.name: Evented
classes.description: A class providing event handling capabilities, including adding/removing listeners, firing events, and propagating events. Used by map and marker objects.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Represents a 2D point with `x` and `y` coordinates, with methods for arithmetic, comparison, and geometric calculations.

classes.name: Bounds
classes.description: Represents a rectangle in pixel coordinates, with methods to extend bounds, check containment, intersection, and size.

classes.name: LatLngBounds
classes.description: Represents a rectangular geographical area with methods to extend bounds, get center, corners, and check containment or intersection.

classes.name: LatLng
classes.description: Represents a geographical point with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude, with methods for comparison, distance, wrapping, and conversions.

classes.name: LatLngBounds
classes.description: Represents a rectangular geographical area with utility methods for extending, containment, and center calculation.

classes.name: LatLng
classes.description: Represents a geographical point with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude, with comparison, distance, and conversion methods.

classes.name: CRS
classes.description: Namespace for various Coordinate Reference Systems used in Leaflet, including a simple CRS mapping longitude/latitude directly to x/y, and predefined systems like EPSG codes.

classes.name: Layer
classes.description: Base class for all map layers, providing methods for adding/removing from map, getting panes, attribution, and handling add/remove events.

classes.name: LayerGroup
classes.description: Class for grouping multiple layers to handle them as a single entity, with methods to add, remove, iterate, and manipulate child layers.

classes.name: FeatureGroup
classes.description: Extended LayerGroup with additional support for event propagation, styling, and bounds calculation for all child layers.

classes.name: Icon
classes.description: Represents icon images used for markers, supporting customization of icon URLs, size, anchor points, and creation of icon elements.

classes.name: IconDefault
classes.description: Default icon for markers, pointing to the standard marker images included with Leaflet, with support for auto-detecting icon paths.

classes.name: Marker
classes.description: Layer representing a clickable, draggable icon on the map with options for icon customization, interactivity, opacity, and event handling.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Abstract class for vector shapes (polylines, polygons, circles), managing options like stroke, fill, style, and rendering behavior.

classes.name: CircleMarker
classes.description: A fixed-size circle overlay with pixel radius, supporting styling, position setting, and interaction handling.

classes.name: Circle
classes.description: A circle overlay with radius in meters, supporting geographic positioning, radius adjustment, and bounding calculations.

classes.name: Polyline
classes.description: Class for drawing multi-point lines, with support for smoothening, path clipping, bounds calculation, and center point computation.

classes.name: Polygon
classes.description: Class for drawing polygon overlays, managing multiple rings and holes, centroid calculation, clipping, and style setting.

classes.name: GeoJSON
classes.description: Class for representing GeoJSON data, able to parse and add GeoJSON features, reset styles, and set styles for vector layers.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends bounds or LatLngBounds to include a point or another bounds.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Returns the geometric center of the bounds.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the bounds or point contains another bounds or point.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Determines if bounds intersect with another bounds.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if bounds overlap with another bounds.

methods.name: toBBoxString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of bounds suitable for web service queries.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if bounds or LatLng are approximately equal.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if bounds are properly initialized.

methods.name: latLngToPoint
methods.description: Projects geographical coordinates to pixel coordinates at a specific zoom level.

methods.name: pointToLatLng
methods.description: Inverse projection from pixel coordinates to geographical coordinates.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Projects a LatLng to the map's coordinate system.

methods.name: unproject
methods.description: Inverse of project, returns LatLng from map coordinates.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Calculates scale factor for a zoom level.

methods.name: zoom
methods.description: Returns zoom level for a scale factor.

methods.name: getProjectedBounds
methods.description: Returns bounds in the projected coordinate system for a given zoom.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates distance between two geographical points.

methods.name: wrapLatLng
methods.description: Wraps longitude and latitude into the CRS bounds.

methods.name: wrapLatLngBounds
methods.description: Wraps a LatLngBounds to ensure its center is within CRS bounds.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Creates a new object that inherits from a prototype, used for class inheritance.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Assigns provided options to the object, extending its default options.

methods.name: toLatLng
methods.description: Converts input to a LatLng object.

methods.name: toPoint
methods.description: Converts input to a Point object.

methods.name: stamp
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for a layer object.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer to the map or layer group.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from the map or layer group.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if a layer is currently added.

methods.name: eachLayer
methods.description: Iterates over all layers in a group or map, applying a function.

methods.name: addTo
methods.description: Convenience method for adding a layer to a map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the layer from its map.

methods.name: getPane
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for a specified map pane.

methods.name: getAttribution
methods.description: Returns the attribution string for the layer.

methods.name: _layerAdd
methods.description: Internal method invoked when a layer is added to a map, setting up event listeners and attribution.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer or layers to a LayerGroup.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from a LayerGroup.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if a layer exists in a LayerGroup.

methods.name: clearLayers
methods.description: Removes all layers from a LayerGroup.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls a specified method on all layers within a group.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Returns a layer by its internal ID.

methods.name: getLayers
methods.description: Returns an array of all layers in a group.

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Sets the z-index for all layers in a group.

methods.name: getLayerId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID (stamp) for a layer.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer to a FeatureGroup with event propagation.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from a FeatureGroup with event propagation.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets style options for all vector layers in the group.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings all layers in the group to front.

methods.name: bringToBack
methods.description: Sends all layers in the group to back.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Calculates and returns the LatLngBounds encompassing all child layers.

methods.name: createIcon
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for a marker icon based on options.

methods.name: createShadow
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for a marker shadow.

methods.name: _createIcon
methods.description: Internal method to generate an icon element of specified type.

methods.name: _setIconStyles
methods.description: Applies size and anchor styles to icon elements.

methods.name: createImg
methods.description: Creates an image DOM element with specified source.

methods.name: _getIconUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the icon or shadow image, supporting retina assets.

methods.name: _detectIconPath
methods.description: Detects the default path for marker icon images by inspecting CSS.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructs an instance, setting coordinates and options.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds marker to the map and initializes icon and interactions.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes marker from map and associated event handlers.

methods.name: getLatLng
methods.description: Returns the marker's geographical coordinate.

methods.name: setLatLng
methods.description: Updates marker position and triggers move event.

methods.name: setZIndexOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the z-index offset for the marker.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the current marker icon object.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Replaces the marker's icon with a new one.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM element representing the marker icon.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Recalculates position and updates DOM element placement.

methods.name: _initIcon
methods.description: Internal method to initialize DOM elements for icon and shadow.

methods.name: _removeIcon
methods.description: Removes the icon DOM element.

methods.name: _removeShadow
methods.description: Removes shadow DOM element if present.

methods.name: _setPos
methods.description: Positions icon and shadow DOM elements.

methods.name: _updateZIndex
methods.description: Updates z-index style for the icon.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Handles marker position during zoom animation.

methods.name: _initInteraction
methods.description: Initializes interaction handlers like dragging and hover effects.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the marker and its shadow.

methods.name: _updateOpacity
methods.description: Applies current opacity to icon and shadow elements.

methods.name: _bringToFront
methods.description: Brings marker to front via z-index adjustment.

methods.name: _resetZIndex
methods.description: Resets marker z-index.

methods.name: _getPopupAnchor
methods.description: Returns popup anchor point based on icon options.

methods.name: _getTooltipAnchor
methods.description: Returns tooltip anchor point based on icon options.

methods.name: setRadius
methods.description: Sets radius of CircleMarker in pixels.

methods.name: getRadius
methods.description: Retrieves current radius of the CircleMarker.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Configures style options for shapes.

methods.name: _project
methods.description: Calculates pixel position of the shape based on geographical position.

methods.name: _updateBounds
methods.description: Updates shape bounds based on radius for hit detection.

methods.name: _updatePath
methods.description: Updates shape rendering.

methods.name: _empty
methods.description: Checks if shape is effectively empty (e.g., radius zero).

methods.name: _containsPoint
methods.description: Hit detection for shape using pixel distance.
